text:
liam_ops: quick check — vendor just said 'partial fill' for EU racks arriving next Tue. any cushion for H100 inference canaries or do we need to gate the deploy?

sophia_infra: how partial? % of the order?

liam_ops: they said ~60% of the chassis due to freight consolidation. so ~40% delayed, unclear ETA.

jamal_procurement: confirmed. vendor note attached in email thread but TL;DR: one container delayed, paperwork cleareship in 2–3 days maybe.

aria_oncall: current EU canary uses 8 H100s reserved in dedicated pool (reserved-a). if we lose 40% we still have ~5, but burst headroom is gone.

liam_ops: ok, we should avoid enabling the full 200qps canary. proposal: drop to 60qps until fill confirmed. thoughts? @sophia_infra @aria_oncall

sophia_infra: +1 on slower canary. also switch canary to lower sequence-length config to keep latency stable while we have fewer cards.

aria_oncall: I'll update canary runtime flags: --max-concurrency=16 --seq-len=512. rolling window for 15m.

liam_ops: nice. jamal can you nudge vendor for manifest number so we can plan cross-dock?

jamal_procurement: pinged them 2m ago. asked for BOL and estimated arrival per-DC. should have update within a business day.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-config-v2 -> EU-dedicated at 2026-03-21T09:00Z (will be blocked if capacity < 6 H100s).

liam_ops: added the deploy block rule. if we hit <6 H100s in the pool we abort and fall back to US-west1 canary.

aria_oncall: logging note: I'll add alert on pool fill-rate dropping below 70% for 10m. also adding runbook step to route traffic to fallback region.

sophia_infra: ops checklist: 1) lower qps 2) adjust seq-len 3) set deploy block 4) monitor fill-rate 5) vendor ETA. I can handle 1–3 now.

liam_ops: perfect. one more ask — finance: any impact on cost if we temporarily push more traffic to US-west? jamal?

jamal_procurement: cost delta should be small for short term; putting a billing alert just in case. created ticket BILL-8923.

aria_oncall: FYI adding a quick snippet to run pool counts:
```
# counts H100 in EU dedicated pool
redwoodctl pool list --region=eu-west1 --sku=h100 --format=table
```

liam_ops: great. we'll reconvene when vendor confirms manifest. thanks all :thumbsup:
